figurative_meaning_en: Glory be to Allah; Allah is great and pure
example_sentences_in_bangla: সুবহানাল্লাহ, এই প্রাকৃতিক সৌন্দর্য দেখে মন ভরে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Subhanallah, this natural beauty fills the heart.
Subhanallah, what immense power Allah has!
history: This phrase originates from Arabic Islamic tradition, used in the Quran and daily prayers to express glorification of God, adopted widely in Bengali Muslim culture through religious practices.
note: Commonly used in Muslim communities; spelling variations arise from Bengali transliteration of Arabic.
